name: GenerateSelfSignedCertificate
syntax: GenerateSelfSignedCertificate( string subject, [any privateKey], [any publicKey], [struct keyPair], [numeric validityDays], [string algorithm] )

params.name: privateKey
params.description: Private key (PEM string or Java object). Provide either privateKey+publicKey OR keyPair.

params.name: publicKey
params.description: Public key (PEM string or Java object). Provide either privateKey+publicKey OR keyPair.

params.name: keyPair
params.description: Struct with 'private' and 'public' keys (from GenerateKeyPair or Lucee's built-in GenerateRSAKeys). Provide either keyPair OR privateKey+publicKey.

params.name: subject
params.description: X.500 distinguished name (e.g., CN=localhost, O=My Company, C=AU)

params.name: validityDays
params.description: Number of days the certificate is valid

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Signature algorithm (e.g., SHA256withRSA, SHA256withECDSA). Auto-detected if omitted.
